title: BNPL Platinum: Determining Your APR Range Based on Credit Tier
summary: Explains how BNPL Platinum assigns an APR range (minimum to maximum placeholders not provided) based on your credit tier at approval, including how highest, mid, and lowest eligible tiers map within that range. Also instructs customers to check their assigned APR in their account after approval.
